title: Late Enrollment Bonus Incentive Terms: Spend Uplift (Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements)
content:
**Term.** On a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement, the enrollment-bonus lateness is the number of whole calendar months from the agreement's approval date to the date the enrollment bonus is credited, and the flown spend since approval is the total of every spend entry posted to the agreement. A late enrollment bonus earns a spend uplift:

- when the lateness reaches 6 months and the flown spend since approval reaches USD 50000, the spend uplift is 20 percentage points;
- when the lateness reaches 6 months and that spend reaches USD 10000 but not 50000, it is 10 percentage points;
- otherwise there is no spend uplift.

**How the uplift acts.** The uplift is counted in percentage points; enrollment-bonus uplifts on different grounds are added together, and the enrollment bonus is raised by the total: the bonus before allowances is the enrollment bonus multiplied by one hundred plus the total uplift, divided by one hundred, rounded down to the whole point.

### Truth table

| Lateness | Flown spend since approval | Spend uplift |
|---|---|---|
| 6 months or more | USD 50000 or more | 20 percentage points |
| 6 months or more | USD 10000 or more, below 50000 | 10 percentage points |
| 6 months or more | below USD 10000 | none |
| fewer than 6 months | any | none |

### Cases (hypothetical)

- Approved on 20 January, credited on 20 July: 6 whole months. With a flown spend of USD 52000.00 the uplift is 20 percentage points, and an enrollment bonus of 5000 points becomes 5000 multiplied by 120 and divided by one hundred, 6000 points, before allowances.
- Approved on 20 January, credited on 19 July: 5 whole months, so no spend uplift, whatever the spend.
